STRATEGY: Staged approach — dual UI with shared core, converging later.

Phase 1 (Core Infrastructure):
- i7-49c.1: ParamRegistry for mixer params (centralizes parameter metadata)
- i7-49c.3: MidiBridge trait (platform-agnostic MIDI abstraction)
- i7-49c.4: nih-plug skeleton (VST3 plugin with SysEx I/O)
- i7-49c.5: Wire DeviceState into nih-plug
- i7-49c.6: Vizia editor window

Phase 2 (Vizia Component Library):
- i7-49c.7-11: Port synth-ui controls (knobs, faders, switches, envelopes, EQ)

Phase 3 (Mixer — MVP):
- i7-49c.12-15: ChannelStrip, MixerPage, TopBar, ToneSelector

Phase 4 (Additional Pages):
- i7-49c.16-18: Routing, Surround, Tone Editors

Phase 5 (Web Migration):
- i7-49c.19-20: Migrate web app to consume ParamRegistry

RATIONALE: Vizia chosen for VST UI because it has first-party nih-plug support, CSS-like styling (closest to React mental model), and nascent WASM support for potential future convergence. The Integra-7 parameter set is frozen (discontinued hardware), bounding long-term maintenance of two UIs.

CRITICAL PATH: i7-49c.1 → i7-49c.4 → i7-49c.5 → i7-49c.6 → i7-49c.7/8/9 → i7-49c.12 → i7-49c.13 (working mixer in VST)
